title: Add canned lines opens a searchable picker showing hours
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  2. A schedule open in the editor with a service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open a schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the service form.
  5. The shop has canned lines defined (Settings). Reach the canned-lines step of the service form.
custom_steps:
1. Read the empty state before any line is added.
  2. Open Add canned lines and use its search; read what each line shows.
  3. Select several lines and reorder them by drag.
  4. Look for any option to create a new canned line from the picker.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The empty state reads "No lines on this service yet" on one line with the button beside it; Add canned lines opens a picker with search.
  • The picker shows hours per line and no price; selected lines are ordered and reorderable by drag.
  • The picker does not offer creating a new canned line (that stays in Settings).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10561 (S4, Attach canned lines to a service), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S4 (unchanged requirements); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
